findings.where: Every way off the page except the email: the top nav's 'Destinations' link (desktop inline and inside the phone 'Menu' panel), the 'MantaHostels' wordmark in the nav, and the footer links 'Privacy', 'Terms' and 'Report content'
findings.fault: The links look live and are styled as links, but none goes anywhere. 'Destinations' points to #destinations, and this page has no destinations section, so a click does nothing. The wordmark, Privacy, Terms and Report content all point back to this same page. A visitor who clicks any of them stays where they are, with no error and no explanation.
findings.who_objects: The backpacker who has just read why they can trust the ranking and wants to start looking at hostels: 'Destinations' is the only onward route, and it fails. A traveller or hostel owner who wants to check the privacy policy or terms, or flag a review, finds nothing. On a page whose job is to earn trust, a footer full of dead legal and reporting links makes the trust claims look empty. Someone reporting content is the person most likely to give up and assume the site doesn't care.

findings.where: End of the page, after 'Hostelworld, for comparison' and before the footer
findings.fault: The page ends with no next step. Nothing after the method takes the visitor to hostels or destinations, the things the ranking is for. The only onward route is the nav at the top, and its 'Destinations' link is dead (see above), so the page is a dead end.
findings.who_objects: A phone visitor who reaches the end of the method page and now trusts the ranking enough to look at hostels. They have to scroll back up and open the menu, and then the link doesn't work. The page convinces them and then gives them nowhere to go.
